info.title: MarketHub API
info.description: Multi-vendor marketplace: catalog, cart, orders, payments, seller and admin back-office.

put.summary: Save a product; you are told when it is back in stock or its price drops
Answer a review publicly (the customer is notified the first time)

post.summary: Upload a product image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, max 5 MB)
Suggested price range from the most similar products in the catalog
Draft a tagline, description, key benefits and specs for a product (AI writer)
Create a discount code for the seller's shop

get.summary: Reviews of a product, sortable and filterable by star rating

post.summary: Review a product the customer has received
Add a photo to your own review (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, max 5 MB, 3 photos)
Mark a review as helpful
Confirm a card payment after the payment form completed (idempotent)
Stripe webhook (payment_intent.succeeded / payment_intent.payment_failed)
Cancel an order that no seller has confirmed yet
Request a return (delivered parcel) or open a dispute on a shop order
Place an order from the cart (COD or CARD)
One-time ticket (valid 60 s) to open the live event stream
Create a customer or seller account (sellers start with a PENDING shop)
Rotate a refresh token and get a new token pair
Revoke a refresh token
Exchange credentials for an access token and a refresh token
Second sign-in step for accounts with two-factor sign-in
Start two-factor setup: returns the secret and otpauth URI to scan
Turn two-factor sign-in on with a code from the authenticator app

patch.summary: Move an order to CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, RETURNED or CANCELLED
Enable or disable a user account (disabling revokes its sessions)
Validate, reject or suspend a seller's shop
Set a shop-specific commission rate (null = platform default)
Approve or reject a return request / dispute

get.summary: Ids of the saved products (to draw the hearts on product cards)
Public shop page
Featured discount codes of a shop that are valid right now
Reviews of the seller's products, newest first
AI sales forecast of the seller's shop
Views, conversion, revenue and returns per day and per product over the last N days
Personalised product recommendations for the signed-in customer
Search the catalog with filters, sorting and pagination
Average, star breakdown and number of reviews with photos
Whether the current user may review this product
Product details (counts a page view for the seller's analytics)
Products similar to this one (same category, best sellers)
Products frequently ordered together with this one (padded with similar products)
Instant search suggestions (products, typos tolerated, and categories)
Search by meaning (AI index), falling back to keyword search when the AI is offline
Filter counts for the same filters as the search
Download the PDF invoice of an order (rendered by the notification service)
Server-sent events: 'notification' events for the ticket's user
Training dataset for the AI service (internal, X-Internal-Key)
Public client configuration (currency, payment provider, shipping rules)
All categories (flat list with parent ids)
The cart; pass a discount code to preview its effect (an invalid code returns 422)
Current user profile
